answer: Custody of 1,000 MiB of unique data shards per identity acts as the scarce resource for AI agents. A verifier challenges agents at a basalt interface, demanding proofs of replication. Honest agents pay for 1,000 units once, whereas 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times the cost. If a tide of shared memory leakage is detected via randomized audits, the system triggers a permanent asset burn. A nadir in entropy during verification seals identity invalidation for 60 epochs.
